messages.content:
List the eight largest moons of Saturn by diameter, largest first. For each
one, output exactly one line in this exact format:

NAME - approximate diameter in kilometers - one distinguishing fact

Output exactly eight lines and nothing else: no heading, no numbering, no
closing remark.

message.content:
Titan - 5150 - largest moon in the Solar System with a dense nitrogen atmosphere
Rhea - 1528 - second largest Saturnian moon with a faint ring system
Iapetus - 1468 - famous for its two-tone surface with dark equatorial stripe
Dione - 1123 - covered in bright icy plains and wispy linear fractures
Tethys - 1062 - features Odysseus crater nearly half its diameter
Enceladus - 504 - actively vents water geysers from its south polar tiger stripes
Mimas - 396 - heavily cratered and resembles the Death Star due to Herschel crater
Hyperion - 270 - highly irregular porous body with chaotic rotation
